info.name: Retrieve emails from a namespace inbox

params.name: apikey
params.description: API authentication key retrieved from the developer console.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Target namespace identifier. Emails are routed to {namespace}.{tag}@inbox.testmail.app.

params.name: tag_prefix
params.description: Filter by tag prefix (wildcard prefix search).

params.name: timestamp_from
params.description: Start time filter in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

params.name: timestamp_to
params.description: End time filter in milliseconds since Unix epoch.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of emails to return per request.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of emails to skip for pagination.

params.name: livequery
params.description: When true, the server waits for new matching emails before responding. Returns HTTP 307 after 60 seconds if no emails arrive; client must follow redirects.

params.name: pretty
params.description: When true, prettifies (indents) the JSON response output.

params.name: headers
params.description: When true, includes raw email headers in each email object.

params.name: spam_report
params.description: When true, includes SpamAssassin spam analysis data (spam_score and spam_report) in each email object.

items.docs: Retrieves test emails from the specified namespace inbox. Supports filtering by tag, timestamp range, and pagination. Optionally waits for new emails with the livequery parameter. If livequery is active and no matching emails arrive within 60 seconds, the server returns HTTP 307 and the client must follow the redirect and resend the request.
